# Yo-Yo Webelos Elective Adventure

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2019/05/LR_Duncan_Original_Logo-300x134.jpg)

Welcome to the fun and exciting Yo-Yo Preview Adventure sponsored by Duncan
Toys.  This elective adventure gives  Webelos the opportunity to learn the
concepts that make a yo-yo work and the basic physics of a pendulum. Duncan
has provide great  instructional videos to help you present this adventure to
your den. It will give Scouts the skills needed to get started with basic yo-
yo tricks.

## Yo-Yo Den Meeting Resources
